title: Manila weighs second South China Sea legal case against Beijing: analyst
snippet: Manila is preparing for a potential second legal case against Beijing over the South China Sea, according to a Philippines-based security analyst. “Indeed, the Philippines is considering filing another case against China, and authorities are already preparing the necessary legal documentation,” said Rommel Banlaoi, president of the Philippine Society for International Security Studies, on Saturday. He made the remarks at a South China Sea symposium in the southern Chinese city of Sanya,...

title: Trump’s war secretary Hegseth and Pacific Command chief Paparo may ‘soon visit China’
snippet: Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth and US Pacific Command head Admiral Samuel Paparo may visit China “soon”, according to a veteran China hand. Stephen Orlins, president of the non-profit organisation National Committee on United States-China Relations (NCUSCR), disclosed the potential visit during a video address at a conference on Friday in Sanya, in southern China’s Hainan province. More than 400 Chinese officials, foreign diplomats and legal experts have gathered in the South China Sea resort city.

title: Are social media platforms censoring France's protest movement?
snippet: Users whose videos were removed or whose views dropped have accused platforms of deliberately suppressing their content under political pressure. While difficult to prove, these suspicions are fueled by the platforms' lack of transparency and the French government's intense scrutiny of their activities.

title: PÖFF Stands With Ukraine: A Look at Films Featured at Tallinn Made Despite, and Because of, the War
snippet: The Estonian fest has been showing solidarity with Ukraine across its film, industry and other programs since the 2022 full-scale invasion of the country by Russia, and its 30th edition is no different.
